summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry describing Cedar Springs, an unincorporated community in western Falls County, Texas. It states the community's status and its location along a named farm-to-market road.
one_line: Cedar Springs is an unincorporated community in west Falls County, Texas, located on Farm-to-market road 2027.
